title: Tools
summary: Hypixel's pickaxes, drills, axes, farming tools, shovels and fishing rods: what each kind gives today, reforges, and where to get them.

SkyBlock tools never break and never need repairing. They are always unbreakable, as on Hypixel.

Pickaxes, axes, farming tools and fishing rods each have their own reforges, rolled at the Blacksmith for coins or applied from a reforge stone (the Ambered stone is for pickaxes). Fishing rods also take Hot Potato Books. See
